answers.rc6_for_autonomous: Middle. winch_ctrl ignores the switch completely while a mission runs; before Start an end position drives the motor by hand, and after a mission/startup/lost radio it must be seen in the middle before it drives again.
answers.pid_on_pi: None. The only PID tuning in the repository is the simulator's src/aerothon_sim/sim_gazebo/config/aerothon_quad.parm (SITL only). aerothon_hardware.parm has no ATC_ values and nothing on the Pi writes PIDs to the FC; the real FC flies whatever is on it.
answers.gazebo_ccw_yaw: Measured after r10, disarmed on the ground: true yaw -0.926 -> -0.672 rad in 53 s wall (~0.6 deg/s sim). FC sends 1100 us (= servo_min, zero command) yet rotor_0/1/3 turn at +18 rad/s and rotor_2 at -18 rad/s; rotor_3 is against its -816 multiplier, so the unbalanced reaction turns the model. Simulator vehicle model only.
answers.yaw_imbalance_40: ArduCopter crash_check.cpp: in flight, the low-passed yaw-rate integrator holding > 75% of ATC_RAT_YAW_IMAX (or at it); the number is the I term as a percentage of yaw output. A constant yaw torque on the airframe: motor tilt/twisted arms, a prop of the wrong direction/pitch, a weak motor or ESC. Not fixed by gains; check motor verticality, props and per-motor outputs (RCOU) in the log.
